# IMAGO International Federation of Cinematographers

> > IMAGO is the international federation of cinematographers, advocating for authorship rights, working conditions, diversity, and technical standards in the global film industry.

IMAGO represents cinematographer societies worldwide, including BSC, ASC, BVK, and AAC. The organization promotes professional standards through technical committees, working conditions advocacy, diversity initiatives, and recognition of outstanding cinematographic achievement through awards and honorary memberships.

## Key Topics

- Cinematography
- Authorship rights
- Working conditions
